resources.scope: whole native command including preparation, both baseline solves, write and strict readback; not incremental allocation

phases.peak_memory_scope: process high-water sampled after hazard projection; includes preparation and earlier stages; later write/readback peaks excluded
phases.solver_wall_scope: native solve_logistic call only; excludes prior construction, final gradient evaluation, centering and diagnostics

preparation.preparation_memory_scope: process high-water mark through single-pass source preparation; not incremental allocation

phases.wall_scope: validation, compression, head fitting and hazard projection timed separately; native solver time is nested within head fitting; preparation and artifact writing separately reported

limits: solver-completed experimental baseline is not coefficient-accuracy or model-admission evidence
kernel block counters do not establish physical i/o bytes
